title: XRP spot, derivatives, ETF-flow, Circle/Coinbase/SBI and Binance network-status reconciliation
retrieval_time_semantics: The retrieval timestamp is the research capture window time. Provider event/publication times are stored separately and are not replaced by this timestamp.

raw_capture.reason: The web retrieval exposed rendered response content, not byte-complete source files and transport headers. No SHA-256 or independent timestamp anchor is claimed.

market_snapshot.daily_open_semantics: Kraken ticker field o is today's open, not a 24-hour open.
interpretation_limits: One venue only; no consolidated NBBO or cross-venue depth.
One top-of-book level only; displayed sizes are transient and not executable-depth curves.
The 28.28 ask/bid size ratio is a single snapshot and is not a stable liquidity imbalance estimate.
The last trade can differ from the current displayed ask because trades and book updates are asynchronous.

observations.venue_scope: seven exchanges: Binance, Bybit, Gate, Bitget, MEXC, Hyperliquid and OKX
observations.long_short_ratio_scope: five exchanges; account-count ratio, not notional exposure

unresolved_same_venue_disagreement.resolution: Do not average. The providers' contract scope, mark-price conversion, capture times and aggregation methods are not sufficiently documented to reconcile this difference.

interpretation: Positive funding and a high long-account fraction indicate long-side crowding risk, not a directional forecast.
Short liquidations exceed long liquidations in the TradRadar observation; a short-covering component is plausible.

TradRadar's seven-venue OI rises while Seandra's Binance-only USD OI is nearly flat. These observations can coexist if other venues drove aggregate growth, but the Binance component itself disagrees materially.
Account ratios are not position notionals, and reported liquidations are lower bounds.
derivatives.source_independence: TradRadar and Seandra are separate aggregators but share Binance as an upstream venue for overlapping data. They are not independent economic sources.

row_semantics.flow_status_computed: Holdings delta; not an issuer-reported AP cash creation/redemption record.
row_semantics.flow_status_excluded: Known capture gap; excluded from computed flow and contributes nothing to the aggregate.
row_semantics.row_status_provisional: May be rewritten by next-morning settlement.
row_semantics.row_status_reconstructed: Daily split estimated from third-party flow estimates between issuer-reported anchors.

scope_warnings: The seven-fund universe includes BITW, a diversified multi-asset index sleeve whose XRP holdings can change through index rebalancing.
GXRP flow is excluded because its issuer page was inaccessible from September 2 to September 28; its later holdings catch-up must not be booked as one day's flow.
XRPR includes some indirect ETP exposure rather than exclusively direct XRP holdings.
Changes below 100 XRP are rounded to zero by the publisher.
Holdings-derived changes can reflect fees or index rebalancing as well as creations/redemptions.
The reported three-day net outflow is approximately 0.0217% of tracked XRP holdings; it is small relative to the stock of holdings.

circle_q3_2026.tazapay_acquisition_status: Definitive agreement signed; expected to close in 2027 subject to regulatory approvals.
circle_q3_2026.arc_mainnet_status: Launched September 16, 2026 with native USDC integration and 100+ institutional/ecosystem builders on day one.
interpretation_limits: USDC transaction volume is gross on-chain transfer volume, not net issuance, unique payments, XRP settlement volume or incremental XRP demand.
The rounded $104B minted and $104B redeemed figures do not establish an exactly zero net flow.
End-period USDC circulation was flat year over year despite average circulation growth.
Reserve income declined while other revenue included $182M from the ARC token presale; EBITDA growth must not be attributed solely to USDC reserve economics.
Tazapay has not been acquired yet; its stated volumes are target-company metrics, not Circle realized volume.
Arc is a competing Circle-controlled settlement/network strategy that may reduce dependence on external ledgers.

coinbase_q3_2026.coinbase_clearing_status: CFTC-approved DCO; Coinbase describes a USDC-native clearinghouse with 24/7 settlement.
interpretation_limits: USDC held in Coinbase products is not XRP holdings or XRP collateral.
Coinbase's reported USDC economics and market share are company-reported, not independently audited XRP demand.
Coinbase Clearing's USDC collateral design is not evidence of XRP collateral eligibility.

coinbase_rlusd_distribution.global_exchange_rlusd_collateral: Future availability; not live at launch.
coinbase_rlusd_distribution.ripple_base_liquidity: Ripple said it would provide liquidity on Base.
coinbase_rlusd_distribution.interpretation: Coinbase is a distribution/trading venue; Ripple's Standard Custody & Trust Company is the issuer. No XRP bridge volume or RLUSD settlement volume was disclosed.

coinbase_custody_security_claim.company_reported_lending_policy: Customer assets are not lent or used unless customers instruct Coinbase.
coinbase_custody_security_claim.company_reported_binance_incident_impact: Coinbase said it was not impacted.
coinbase_custody_security_claim.source_status: Coinbase self-description; not an independent audit or proof of XRP-specific custody balances.

sbi_visa_crypto_rewards.mechanism: Card reward points can be automatically converted into the crypto asset selected by the cardholder and credited to an SBI VC Trade account.
interpretation_limits: This is a retail distribution/rewards channel, not evidence of direct card-funded XRP purchases.
No XRP reward conversion volume, cardholder count, market execution or net spot demand was disclosed.

sbi_vctrade_rlusd.legal_classification: SBI VC Trade classified RLUSD as a Japanese No. 4 electronic payment instrument for its VCTRADE service.
sbi_vctrade_rlusd.issuer: Standard Custody & Trust Company, LLC, a Ripple subsidiary.
sbi_vctrade_rlusd.fees: SBI announced no-fee deposits and withdrawals.

network_scope.official_release: The SBI official release does not name the supported chain.
network_scope.secondary_launch_reporting: New Economy reported Ethereum-only support at launch: https://www.neweconomy.jp/posts/586315
network_scope.current_status: No later official SBI VC Trade announcement confirming XRPL deposit/withdrawal support was found in this research.
network_scope.global_rlusd_networks: RLUSD exists natively on Ethereum and XRPL; global support must not be confused with SBI's domestic service network.

binance_post_incident_withdrawal_network.status: Gradual resumption after per-asset/network security checks; not all pairs enabled simultaneously.
binance_post_incident_withdrawal_network.deposits: Binance said deposits were operating normally.
binance_post_incident_withdrawal_network.loss_allocation: Binance said it would bear losses from the stolen funds rather than pass them to users.
interpretation_limits: The BSC XRP entry is a network-specific representation and does not establish native XRPL XRP withdrawal status.
The XRP-network entry is the exact publisher string RLUSDFD; do not silently normalize it to RLUSD without token-issuer/contract verification.
This notice does not establish recovery of stolen XRP or customer-level restoration amounts.

source_independence.kraken: Primary exchange API for its own XRP/USD ticker only.
source_independence.tradradar_and_seandra: Separate aggregators with overlapping Binance upstream data; not independent economic observations.
source_independence.xrp_insights: Aggregator using issuer holdings pages; holdings-derived flow estimates are not issuer AP cash-flow reports.
source_independence.circle_sec: Primary issuer filing hosted by SEC; Circle pressroom republication would not count as an independent source.
source_independence.coinbase: Primary company disclosures for Coinbase products, performance and custody claims.
source_independence.sbi: Primary company disclosures for SBI card and RLUSD distribution; secondary network support reporting is explicitly separated.
source_independence.binance: Primary exchange notice for its own withdrawal/network status.

competing_hypotheses.statement: The short-liquidation skew and rising multi-venue OI are consistent with a short-covering component, while positive funding and a 76% long-account share indicate crowding risk.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Seandra reports Binance USD OI nearly flat over 24 hours; provider OI values disagree materially for Binance.

competing_hypotheses.statement: A spot-led advance remains possible if unobserved venues or OTC flows absorbed supply while aggregate derivatives OI increased.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: The current ETF aggregate shows small net outflows; no synchronized cross-venue spot trade imbalance or verified exchange-wallet netflow is present.

competing_hypotheses.statement: USDC and RLUSD expansion on XRPL can increase ledger activity and dollar liquidity while some settlement routes bypass XRP as a bridge asset.
competing_hypotheses.disconfirming_evidence: Coinbase RLUSD launch on XRPL and SBI/Ripple distribution can increase access and possible complementarity, but route-level XRP usage is undisclosed.

reasons: Rendered captures do not have byte-complete raw receipts and independent timestamp anchors.
Derivatives providers disagree materially on Binance open interest.
ETF flow figures are holdings-derived and include product-specific caveats.
No synchronized venue-level spot order-book/trade imbalance, verified exchange-wallet flow or route-level XRP payment volume is included.
Circle and Coinbase corporate disclosures do not establish XRP-specific demand.
